40006527.author: पदार्थः
40006527.content: इति उकत्वा having said so, लक्ष्मण श्रीमान्  graceful Lakshmana, प्रहसन्निव  with a smile, विराधे at Viradha, कः भवान् who are you? वनमभ्येत्य having come to the forest, यथासुखम् at will, चरिष्यसि you are roaming about.

40006527.author: Translation
40006527.content: Graceful Lakshmana asked  Viradha  with a smile, Who are you wandering in the forest at will ?.

40006528.author: पदार्थः
40006528.content: अथ then, विराथः Viradha, वनम् forest, पूरयन् filling with echoes, पुनः again, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said, पृच्छतः asked, मम me, ब्रूतम् whereabouts, युवाम् you both, कौ who are you, क्व where, गमिष्यथः going.

40006528.author: Translation
40006528.content: Then Viradha with his voice filling the forest said, Instead of asking about me you both should speak out who  you are and where you are going

40006529.author: पदार्थः
40006529.content: ततः thereafter, सुमहातेजाः highly effulgent, रामः Rama, पृच्छन्तम् when asked, ज्वलिताननम् burning countenance, तं राक्षसम् to that demon, आत्मनः his, इक्ष्वाकुकुलम् Ikshvaku family, उवाच described.

40006529.author: Translation
40006529.content: Questioned by the demon, who bore a burning countenance, the highly effulgent Rama introduced his Ikshvaku family:

40006530.author: पदार्थः
40006530.content: नौ both of us, वृत्तसम्पन्नौ endowed with good lineage, वनगोचरौ both moving in the forest, क्षत्रियौ two kshatriyas, विद्धि know, त्वां तु about you, वेदितुम् wish to know, इच्छावः we both wish, दण्डकान् in the Dandaka forest, चरसि you are going about, त्वम् you, कः tell.

40006530.author: Translation
40006530.content: Know us to be both kshatriyas, endowed with a good lineage and yet moving in the forest. We both wish to know, who you are and why you are going about in Dandaka forest?

40006531.author: पदार्थः
40006531.content: विराधस्तु Viradha also, सत्यपराक्रमम् one with truth as his prowess, तं रामम् to that Rama, उवाच said, हन्त O, राजन् to king, राघव Rama, ते to you, वक्ष्यामि I will tell, मम myself, निबोध  know.

40006531.author: Translation
40006531.content: Then Viradha said to Rama whose truth was his strength, I will tell you who I am. O, listen:

40006532.author: पदार्थः
40006532.content: अहम् I am, जयस्य Jaya's, पुत्रः son, किल indeed, शतह्रदा Satahrada, मम my, माता mother,  पृथिव्याम् on this earth, सर्वराक्षसाः all the demons, माम् me, विराधः Viradha इति so, आहुः call me.

40006532.author: Translation
40006532.content: I am indeed son to Jaya. My mother is Satahrada. Verily all the demons on this earth call me Viradha.

40006533.author: पदार्थः
40006533.content: तपसा through penance, ब्रह्मणः from Brahma, प्रसादजा bestowed by his pleasure, लोके in this world, शस्त्रेण with any weapon, अवध्यता not to be killed, अभिसम्प्राप्ता has been acquired, अच्छेद्याभेद्यत्वमेव च  not to be cut or broken by any.

40006533.author: Translation
40006533.content: By the grace of Lord Brahma I was bestowed with this prowess through my penance. In this world none can kill me with a weapon nor split nor cut me to pieces.

40006534.author: पदार्थः
40006534.content: एनाम् this lady, प्रमदाम् woman, उत्सृज्य on giving up, अनपेक्षौ without claiming her, त्वरमाणौ quickly, यथागतम् to the place where you came from, पलायेथाम् both of you may run, वाम् to you both, जीवितम् life, न आददे I will not take away.

40006534.author: Translation
40006534.content: Therefore, leave this lady and run away to the place you came from. I will not take away your life .

40006535.author: पदार्थः
40006535.content: रामः Rama, कोपसंरक्तलोचनः with eyes reddened due to anger, विकृताकारम् with deformed appearance, पापचेतसम् with sinful intentions, तम् him, विराधं राक्षसम् to demon Viradha, प्रत्युवाच replied.

40006535.author: Translation
40006535.content: With eyes reddened with anger Rama replied to the sinful, deformed Viradha:

40006536.author: पदार्थः
40006536.content: क्षुद्र O vile creature, हीनार्थम् mean, त्वाम् you, धिक् fie upon, ध्रुवम् surely, मृत्युम् death, अन्वेषसे you are seeking, सन्तिष्ठ stay, रणे in war, प्राप्स्यसे you will attain, जीवन् while being alive, मे me, न गमिष्यासि you will not go.

40006536.author: Translation
40006536.content: O vile, mean creature  surely you are seeking death. Wait, you will meet it in the fight.

40006537.author: पदार्थः
40006537.content: ततः then, रामः Rama, धनुः bow, सज्यम् strung, कृत्वा after setting, सुनिशितान् sharp, शरान् arrows, सुशीघ्रम् quickly, अभिसन्धाय after aiming, राक्षसम् rakshasa, निजघान hit,  ह indeed.

40006537.author: Translation
40006537.content: Then Rama strung his bow immediately, shot the sharp arrows at Viradha and hit him verily.

40006538.author: पदार्थः
40006538.content: धनुषा bow, ज्यागुणवता string tied, महावेगान् swift ones, सुपर्णानिलतुल्यगान् in speed comparable to Garuda and the windgod, रुक्मपुङ्खान् with bright feathers, सप्त बाणान् seven arrows, मुमोच ह verily released.

40006538.author: Translation
40006538.content: From his bow  strung tight,  Rama shot seven swift, goldenfeathered arrows comparable to Garuda  and the Windgod in speed.

40006539.author: पदार्थः
40006539.content: पावकोपमाः looking like fire, ते they, बर्हिणवाससः arrows tied with peacock feathers, विराधस्य Viradha's, शरीरम् body, भित्त्वा after piercing, शोणितादिग्धाः drenched in blood, धरण्याम् on the ground, निपेतुः fell.

40006539.author: Translation
40006539.content: The arrows tied with peacockfeathers, looking like fire, pierced the body of Viradha which, drenched in blood, fell on the ground.

40006540.author: पदार्थः
40006540.content: विद्धः Pierced, सः he, राक्षसः that rakshasa, तदा then, वैदेहीम् Sita, न्यस्य  left her, शूलम् a spear, उद्यम्य after lifting, सुसङ्कृद्धः with intense anger, सलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, रामम् towards Rama, अभ्यद्रवत् ran towards.

40006540.author: Translation
40006540.content: Hit  by Rama and Lakshmana, the enraged  demon left Vaidehi, lifted a sharp spear   and ran towards them.

40006541.author: पदार्थः
40006541.content: तदा then, सः that, महानादम् loud noise, विनद्य producing, शक्रध्वजोपमम् like Indra's banner, शूलम् spike, प्रगृह्य taking, व्यात्ताननः with wide open mouth, अन्तकः god of death, इव like, अशोभत shone.

40006541.author: Translation
40006541.content: The demon who produced a great noise with his wide open mouth resembled the god of death. He lifted a sharp spike that looked like Indra's banner.

40006542.author: पदार्थः
40006542.content: अथ and then, तौ both, भ्रातरौ brothers, कालान्तकयमोपमे looking like Yama, the god of death, तस्मिन् at him, राक्षसे  at that  demon, विराधे on Viradha, दीप्तम् bright, शरवर्षम् rain of arrows, ववर्षतुः showered.

40006542.author: Translation
40006542.content: And then both the brothers showered bright arrows on the demon Viradha who looked like Yama, the god of death.

40006543.author: पदार्थः
40006543.content: महारौद्रः extremely frightening, सः राक्षस: that rakshasa, प्रहस्य after laughing, स्थित्वा  stood there, अजृम्भत yawned, जृम्भमाणस्य as he was yawning, कायात् from the body, आशुगाः swiftmoving, ते बाणाः those arrows, निष्पेतुः fell down.

40006543.author: Translation
40006543.content: The demon who was extremely frightening stood there, laughing and yawning.  As he yawned, all the swiftlyflying arrows fell out of his body.

40006544.author: पदार्थः
40006544.content: राक्षसः demon, विराधः Viradha, वरदानेन by virtue of a boon, स्पर्शात् तु by touch as well, प्राणान् (Prana, Apana, Vyana, Udana, and Samana) vital breath, संरोध्य  controlled, शूलम्  spike, उद्यम्य on taking out, राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, अभ्यधावत ran after.

40006544.author: Translation
40006544.content: By virtue of a boon Viradha, the demon, controlled the vital breath of his body by a mere touch and, raising the spike, ran towards the two Raghava princes.

40006545.author: पदार्थः
40006545.content: शस्त्रभृताम् among the wielders of bows, वरः best, रामः Rama, ज्वलनोपमम् like burning fire, वज्रसङ्काशम् resembling thunderbolt, तत् that, शूलम्  spike, द्वाभ्याम् with two, शराभ्याम् arrows, गगने in the sky, चिच्छेद broke asunder.

40006545.author: Translation
40006545.content: With two arrows, Rama, the best among wielders of weapons, broke down the spike in the sky burning like fire, and resembling the  thunderbolt of Indra.

40006546.author: पदार्थः
40006546.content: रामविशिखैः by Rama's arrow, छिन्नम् broken, तत् शूलम् spike, भुवि on the ground, अपतत् fell, अशनिना by the thunder, छिन्नम् broken into pieces, मेरोः of mount Meru, शिलातलम् इव like a slab, पपात fell down.

40006546.author: Translation
40006546.content: The spike, broken down by Rama's arrow, fell like a slab of mount Meru splintered by Indra's thunder.

40006547.author: पदार्थः
40006547.content: तदा then, तौ both, उद्यतौ coming on, कृष्णसर्पोपमौ both looking like black serpents, शुभौ auspicious, ख़ड्गौ the two swords, क्षिप्रम् quickly, उद्यम्य raising, तूर्णम् at once, तस्य at him, आपेततुः fell upon, बलात् strongly, प्रहरताम् struck  तस्य him.

40006547.author: Translation
40006547.content: Then both Rama and Lakshmana quickly raised their swords which looked like black serpents and at once fell upon the demon who was going to strike with great force.

40006548.author: पदार्थः
40006548.content: वध्यमानः being struck, रौद्रः angry one, सः he, अप्रकम्प्यौ the unshakeable two, नरव्याघ्रौ two tigerlike men, तौ both, भुजाभ्याम् with his arms, सुभृशम् tightly, परिगृह्य holding, प्रस्थातुम् to set out, ऐच्छत intended.

40006548.author: Translation
40006548.content: Struck down, the angry demon tightly caught hold of both of them under his arms and wanted to set out, carrying Rama and Lakshmana, the two unshakeable tigers among men.

40006549.author: पदार्थः
40006549.content: तस्य his, अभिप्रायम् intention, आज्ञाय having understood, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said, अयं राक्षसः this demon, अनेन पथा by this path, अलम् no need to prohibit, वहतु तावत् let him carry us.

40006549.author: Translation
40006549.content: Rama understood the intention of the demon and said to Lakshmana, Let him go his way, no need to stop him.

40006550.author: पदार्थः
40006550.content: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, राक्षसः the demon, यथा as, इच्छति wishes to go, तथा like that, वहतु let him carry, निशाचरः nightstalker येन by which ever, याति moves, अयमेव this alone, सः such, पन्थाः हि direction only.

40006550.author: Translation
40006550.content: O Lakshmana, let the nightstalker go the way he wishes. That is, in fact, our path.

40006551.author: पदार्थः
40006551.content: अतिबलोद्धतः one puffed with great strength, सः that Viradha, निशाचरः तु rakshasa on his part, स्वबलवीर्येण by his own strength, समुत्क्षिप्य after lifting, बालाविव like two children, स्कन्धगतौ on both his shoulders, चकार made.

40006551.author: Translation
40006551.content: Puffed up with his own great strength, Viradha lifted them and placed them on his shoulders as though they were two children.

40006552.author: पदार्थः
40006552.content: ततः then, रजनीचरः the nightstalker, विराधः Viradha, तौ both राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, स्कन्धम् on the shoulders, आरोप्य keeping, घोरम् dreadfuly, विनदन् while screaming, वनम् अभिमुखः towards the forest, जगाम proceeded.

40006552.author: Translation
40006552.content: Then the nightstalker proceeded towards the forest, carrying both the scions of the Raghu race on his shouldersroaring.
